title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents today for follow-up regarding management of type 2 diabetes.

History of Present Illness
The patient reports an episode of hypoglycemia over the past few days. Symptoms included shakiness and sweating. The patient is on long-term insulin therapy for his type 2 diabetes mellitus. He reports adherence to his current insulin regimen.

Medication List
Insulin (Long-term)

Exam
Vitals are stable. Cardiovascular and pulmonary exams are unremarkable.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus: Stable, managed with insulin.
2. Hypoglycemia: Current episode being monitored.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen. Educated patient on recognizing early signs of hypoglycemia and appropriate management. Follow up as needed.
explanations: Diabetes with hypoglycemia and no coma documented: E11.649.
Long-term insulin use in type 2 diabetes: add Z79.4.

distractors.why: Hypoglycemia is a complication with its own code.
Z79.4 is required for routine insulin use in type 2 diabetes.
